success.title: Steam connected
success.description: Return to the Mini App: it will detect your verification automatically. You can close this tab.

invalid.title: Could not verify sign-in
invalid.description: Return to the Mini App and create a new Steam linking URL.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.description: Links are single-use and short-lived. Create a new link in the Mini App.

cancelled.title: Sign-in cancelled
cancelled.description: You can connect Steam again from the Mini App.

unavailable.title: Steam is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.description: Return to the Mini App and try connecting Steam later.

conflict.title: Account already connected
conflict.description: This Steam account is already linked to a profile. Existing links cannot be replaced automatically.

steam.privacy: SQUAD does not receive your Steam password, access codes or session. Steam verifies your account.
